hero.title: How to use TubeMine.
hero.sub: Quick start, plans, output formats, limits, and common errors.

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: TubeMine reads a YouTube video's public comments and returns audience analytics: sentiment direction, the most frequent words, and the most frequent emoji. Paste a URL and the results are ready in seconds.
overview.p2: It is for creators, marketing analysts, ML researchers, indie developers, and anyone who wants the audience signal without manually scrolling through hundreds of comments.

quickstart.title: Quick start (no account needed)
quickstart.p1: Anonymous visitors can analyze any public video without signing in.
quickstart.b1_text: The home page form accepts any standard YouTube video URL (shortened, full, or with a timestamp).
quickstart.b2_text: TubeMine fetches the video's title, channel, view count, like count, and comment count so you can verify it is the right video before analysis.
quickstart.b3_text: Results render in the browser and a CSV is built client-side with columns author, text, likes, replies, publishedAt.
quickstart.callout_text: 1,000 comments per IP per video. Results live in your browser only until you close the tab. Sign in to bump the limit to 5,000 comments per month and save up to 10 analyses to history.

signin.title: Sign in for the Free plan
signin.p1: Signing in with Google switches you from per-IP limits to a per-account monthly budget, adds the qualitative sentiment label, and persists your last analyses to history.
signin.b1_text: The /login route handles OAuth. No password to remember.
signin.b2_text: Counted across all videos you analyze in the calendar month; resets on the 1st.
signin.b3_text: Each analysis shows a qualitative bar for sentiment direction (positive, neutral, negative). Pro adds exact percentages.
signin.b4_strong: Last 10 analyses saved with CSV download.
signin.b4_text: Visit /history to revisit prior runs. CSV columns match anonymous: author, text, likes, replies, publishedAt.

pro.title: Pro flow ($19/month)
pro.p1: Pro is $19 per month with a 3-day free trial. It adds exact sentiment percentages, full word and emoji rankings, JSON and Excel exports, a 100,000-comment monthly budget, and 100 saved analyses in history.
pro.b1_text: Pro costs $19 / month. New signups get a 3-day free trial; you only pay on day 4 if you stay.
pro.b2_text: After your first charge, you have 7 days to request a refund through the customer portal. The trial and refund windows do not stack: the trial runs before any charge; the refund window starts only once billing begins.
pro.b3_text: Pro is month to month, no minimum term. Cancel from the customer portal in two clicks.
pro.b4_strong: 100,000 comments per month, 100 saved analyses, exact sentiment plus trends.
pro.b4_text: JSON and Excel exports available from /dashboard and /history.

formats.title: Output formats (CSV, JSON, Excel)
formats.p1: Three formats are available, by tier.
formats.csv_text: Columns: author, text, likes, replies, publishedAt. Generated client-side via Papa Parse. Cells starting with =, +, -, @ are sanitized to prevent formula injection when you open the file in Excel or Sheets.
formats.json_text: Same record schema as CSV plus the analysis aggregates: sentiment percentages, top words, top emoji. Downloaded from /dashboard or /history. The 'API coming soon' qualifier on the pricing page refers to a planned public REST API for developers; the JSON file download itself works today.
formats.xlsx_text: Generated server-side. Same data as JSON. Same formula-injection sanitization as CSV.
formats.p2_security: Formula-injection sanitization (shipped 2026-05-21) covers ASCII =, +, -, @ plus their full-width Unicode variants. OWASP-recommended hardening for any user-generated content exported to spreadsheets.

limits.title: Limits and quotas
limits.p1: Quotas are tracked separately per tier.
limits.ip_text: 1,000 comments per IP per video. Monthly per-IP budget resets on the 1st of the next calendar month.
limits.user_text: Budget tied to your Google sign-in: 5,000 / month for Free, 100,000 / month for Pro. Resets on the 1st. Current usage and reset date visible at /profile.
limits.yt_text: TubeMine uses its own shared quota with the YouTube Data API v3, so you never need your own API key. If our shared quota is exhausted for the day you may see the message 'TubeMine has hit its YouTube API daily quota'; the quota refreshes daily on YouTube's schedule.

troubleshoot.title: Troubleshooting common errors
troubleshoot.p1: If extract or preview fails, here is how to read the most common error messages.
troubleshoot.err1_a: The URL is invalid, or the video is private or has been removed. Verify the URL by opening it in a YouTube tab; TubeMine only works with public videos.
troubleshoot.err2_q: "Comments are disabled for this video by the uploader"
troubleshoot.err2_a: The video's uploader has turned off comments on YouTube itself; there is no comment thread to analyze.
troubleshoot.err3_q: "TubeMine has hit its YouTube API daily quota. Please try again tomorrow."
troubleshoot.err3_a: Our shared YouTube Data API quota for the day is exhausted. It refreshes daily on YouTube's schedule; try again the next day.
troubleshoot.err4_q: "Monthly Pro cap reached. Resets on the 1st." / "Free tier cap reached. Upgrade for 100,000 comments/month."
troubleshoot.err4_a: Your account has hit its monthly cap (5,000 for Free, 100,000 for Pro). The quota resets on the 1st of the next calendar month. Current usage and reset date are visible at /profile.
troubleshoot.err5_a: Anonymous-visitor monthly per-IP cap. Sign in with Google to switch to a per-account budget (5,000 Free, 100,000 Pro).

meta.title: Privacy · TubeMine
meta.description: Plain English about what TubeMine collects, why, and what we never do.

hero.title: Privacy.
hero.sub: Plain English about what we collect, why, and what we never do.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.p1: TubeMine collects the minimum needed to run the product. There are no marketing trackers, no enrichment pipelines, no behavioral profiles.
collect.b1_text: Your email address and display name when you sign in with Google. Nothing more.
collect.b2_text: Timestamps and comment counts per analysis. We use these to enforce your monthly cap and show your history.
collect.b3_text: Only at request time, only for rate limiting and abuse detection. Not stored beyond 24 hours.
collect.callout_text: the comment text itself, beyond a 30 day analysis cache that is purged automatically. The cache is needed so we can re-render your past results without re-querying YouTube.

never.title: What we never do
never.p1: This list is short on purpose. These promises are part of why TubeMine exists.
never.b1_text: We do not sell, rent, or share your data with any third party.
never.b2_text: The only analytics we use is Vercel Analytics, which is server-side, IP-anonymized, and cookie-free.
never.b3_text: No conversion tags, no remarketing audiences, no cross-site identifiers.
never.b4_text: We do not run canvas, font, or device-class fingerprinting.

youtube.title: YouTube data
youtube.p1: TubeMine queries the official YouTube Data API v3 server-side with our own API key. When you paste a YouTube URL, your browser sends that URL to TubeMine, then our server makes the API call to Google.
youtube.p2_strong: Your IP address is not sent to Google for analysis calls.
youtube.p2_text: Google sees our server's IP, not yours.
youtube.p3: Comments are public data, the same data anyone scrolling a YouTube video can see. TubeMine never accesses private channels, unlisted videos, or anything that requires owner authentication.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.b1_tail: It is required to keep you signed in.
cookies.p2: That is the entire cookie inventory. No tracking cookies, no marketing cookies, no consent banner because there is nothing to consent to.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1_prefix: You can ask us to delete all the data we hold about you at any time. Email
rights.p1_tail: from the address on your account and we will purge within 7 days. You will receive a confirmation when the purge is complete.
rights.p2: If you are a resident of the EU, UK, or California, the rights granted by GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA apply. The mechanism is the same: one email.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1_prefix: If we change this policy in a way that affects what we collect or what we do with it, we will email every existing user at least
changes.p1_tail: the change applies. Non-material edits (typo fixes, link updates) are not announced but the "Last updated" date at the top of this page will change.

asis.title: Provided as-is
asis.p1_tail: , without warranty of any kind, express or implied. We work hard to keep the service running, but we cannot guarantee 100 percent uptime, error-free analysis, or that any specific feature will keep working forever.
asis.p2: Use TubeMine to inform decisions, not to make irreversible ones. Sentiment models can be wrong. Comment counts can lag behind YouTube. Always sanity check before you publish a number.

youtube.p1_link: Google's YouTube API Services Terms of Service

youtube.p2: We access only public comment data via the official API. No unauthorized fetching, no private endpoints, no owner-only data.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.p1: A few non-negotiable rules. They exist to keep the service usable for everyone on a shared API quota.
use.b1_strong: No abuse of the shared API key.
use.b1_text: Do not script TubeMine to burn through quota for other users. Rate limits are enforced.
use.b2_strong: No automated harvesting behind our API.
use.b2_text: The product is for humans analyzing videos. Mass programmatic pipelines are not what this is for.
use.b3_text: You may use analysis results in your own reports, decks, and content. You may not repackage the underlying comment data and sell it.
use.b4_text: Your downstream use of insights from TubeMine, including any decisions based on them, is your responsibility.

suspension.title: Account suspension
suspension.p1: We can suspend accounts that abuse the service in any of the ways listed above, or that put the platform's stability or quota at risk. Suspension is not our first move.
suspension.p2_strong: We will email you before suspending
suspension.p2_tail: , explain what we observed, and give you a reasonable window to respond. Egregious cases (active exploitation, repeated quota exhaustion after a warning) may skip the warning.

pricing.p1_tail: before the change applies to their billing. You can cancel any time in that window through the customer portal and pay the old rate for any remaining cycle.

docs.meta_description: Connect the TubeMine MCP server to Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Claude Desktop, and more. One tool, authentication, limits, and troubleshooting.
docs.hero_sub: Connect TubeMine to your AI assistant once, then pull the comments of any YouTube video straight from your chat. Pick your client below.
docs.what_p1: TubeMine MCP is a remote Model Context Protocol server that lets your AI assistant pull YouTube comments directly inside the chat. Base models cannot fetch YouTube comments on their own, so TubeMine fills that gap and hands the raw data back to your model. Your own AI does any analysis you ask for.
docs.what_tool_returns: The raw comment thread: author, text, likes, replies, and timestamps. No summary, no scoring. Your model reads the data and answers your question.
docs.what_param_video_url: a public YouTube URL or video ID
docs.auth_p1: Every client authenticates with an API key (v1). Send your key in an Authorization: Bearer header in the client config or connect command, exactly as shown in each setup section below.
docs.auth_p2_prefix: Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor will get one-click OAuth in a future release. For now they use the same API key as every other client.
docs.auth_p3_prefix: Get and manage your key on the
docs.auth_p3_tail: page. From there you can rotate the key (which revokes the old one on every connected client) or revoke a single client.
docs.auth_callout: Treat your key like a password. It grants access to your TubeMine quota. Never commit it to a public repository.
docs.setup_oauth_p: This client supports a connect command. Replace YOUR_KEY with your API key, then run it once.
docs.setup_command_p: Run this once in your terminal. Replace YOUR_KEY with your API key.
docs.setup_config_p_prefix: Add a TubeMine entry to the config file below. Replace YOUR_KEY with your API key, then restart the client.
docs.setup_steps_p: Follow these steps in the client, then paste your API key when prompted.
docs.setup_oauth_note: OAuth one-click is coming for this client. Use the API key today.
docs.limits_p1: MCP shares the same monthly comment quota as the web app. It is not a separate quota. A call that fetches comments counts those comments against your monthly total, the same way an analysis in the dashboard does.
docs.limits_free_text: 5,000 comments per month. Generous for trying the tool and light use.
docs.limits_pro_text: 100,000 comments per month for heavier, regular workflows.
docs.limits_p2: There is no hard per-call cap today. We ask only that usage stays within fair-use bounds so the service stays fast for everyone.
docs.limits_p3: TubeMine reads comments through the official YouTube Data API, which has a shared daily quota. On rare busy days that quota can be exhausted. When it is, a call returns a clean error asking you to try again tomorrow. Your monthly comment quota is untouched.
docs.trouble_p1: Most issues fall into one of these.
docs.trouble_key_text_prefix: Make sure you copied the full key and that it is sent as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY. If you rotated recently, the old key is dead. Rotate or create a new key on
docs.trouble_notools_text: Most clients load MCP config at startup. Fully quit and reopen the client after editing the config so it picks up the new server.
docs.trouble_handlers_term: Missing GET, POST, or DELETE handlers
docs.trouble_handlers_text: This means the client reached the wrong endpoint. Confirm the server URL is exactly https://tubemine.tech/mcp, with no trailing path, and use the HTTP transport.
docs.trouble_contact_tail: with your client and the error and we will help.
